description: Authored two-piece tube block clamp with configured fabricated halves and separately identified standard hardware.
releaseRequirements: Measure tube OD, ovality and wall thickness; qualify bore fit, residual split gap and resistance to rotation without crushing the tube.
Specify half material, machining or printing route, tolerances, bearing-face flatness and finish.
Resolve fastener grade, locking method, torque, mounting stack and joint proof loads for the actual vehicle.
Check fatigue, vibration, polymer creep and carbon tube local bearing before vehicle use.
